<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
stems={0:21,1:26,2:31,3:36,4:41}  # bit->col
def ts(fr):
    s=fr.segmentation; out=['w']*5
    for n in s['nodes']:
        if n['pixels']==3 and n['boundary'][0][0]>=44:
            c=n['boundary'][0][1]; ii=[k for k,v in stems.items() if v==c]
            if ii: out[ii[0]]='B' if n['color']=='B' else 'w'
    return ''.join(out)
def g(i): return i^(i>>1)
cur=0  # wwwww
prev_g=0
seq=[]
for i in range(1,32):
    gi=g(i)
    diff=gi^prev_g
    bit=diff.bit_length()-1
    seq.append(bit)
    prev_g=gi
print("Gray toggle bits (bit0=T1..bit4=T5):",seq)
# Execute, checking for completion
start_step=current_frame.step
for k,bit in enumerate(seq):
    col=stems[bit]
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':45,'col':col}])
    st=ts(current_frame)
    res=last_action_result
    done=res.get('done') or res.get('level_completed') or res.get('run_complete') or res.get('game_over')
    print(f"t{k+1} bit{bit} -> {st} step{current_frame.step} done={done}")
    if done:
        print("STOPPED: level/game event")
        break
print("final step",current_frame.step,"T=",ts(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
